title: Adorable decorations that don't ship very well.
text:
Adorable decorations that don't ship very well.. I wanted to buy these because they were just funny, in my opinion.
You don't have to be into gore to enjoy it.
It can be for Halloween or for baking/cooking decorated cupcakes for your favorite chef.

I would have enjoyed them even more, had they arrived whole. Instead, half of ours were broken and cracked.
I haven't tried to glue them back together with syrup or something yet, because I haven't opened the package yet.
Disappointing.
Better if you buy these in the store, where you can see the condition before you purchase them.
